ui.indexDescription: Choose the services you need from initial consultation to preparation of documents, registration and visa.
ui.opportunitiesDescription: Check out guides to study, work, immigration, exams and destination countries.
ui.whoFor: Who is this service suitable for?
ui.processIntro: The steps vary by case type, but the general service path includes the following.
ui.prepareIntro: Organize relevant information and documents from scratch for a more accurate assessment.
ui.important: No application, acceptance or visa result is guaranteed. The final decision rests with the university, examination authority or government authority.

services.title: Expert advice
services.description: Review the goal, conditions, budget, and realistic options to build a clear path.
services.audience: For people who decide between several educational, work or immigration paths or need an evaluation to start a case.
included: Identification of risks and necessary documents

services.title: Registration of scholarships
services.description: Choosing the right scholarship and regularly preparing the application based on the official requirements.
services.audience: For applicants who have the basic conditions of the scholarship and want to make a complete and trackable application.
included: Check the conditions of the scholarship

services.title: Registration for exams
services.description: Guidance for choosing and registering for the required language or admission test.
services.audience: For applicants who need to coordinate their exam type, center, date or registration information with their destination.
prepare: The name according to the identity document

services.title: Immigration registration
services.description: Step-by-step adjustment of immigration requests based on route and official reference.
services.audience: For people who have a clear legal path and want help in setting up documents, forms and scheduling.

services.title: Preparation of documents
services.description: Set up, name and control documents for admission, scholarship, work or visa.
services.audience: For every applicant who needs a complete, legible file according to the official destination list.

services.title: During the documentation process
services.description: Guidance for translation, verification, certification and administrative procedures of documents.
services.audience: For cases whose documents require official translation, administrative approval or consular procedures.
process: Checking the destination of the document

services.title: Application
services.description: Prepare and submit applications for education, work, and immigration services with careful information review.
services.audience: For applicants who need a complete and organized application for the relevant authority.

services.title: Coordination
services.description: Coordinate communication, scheduling, and case steps for organized application progress.
services.audience: For applicants who need coordination between advisers, institutions, and related authorities.

services.title: Visa and residence
services.description: Preparation of visa and residence application based on admission, purpose of travel and destination regulations.
services.audience: For applicants who have an acceptance, invitation or legal basis for travel and need to prepare their visa file.
included: Arrangement of financial and residency documents
Preparation for an appointment or interview
